Maya Rao: quick idea1 22 dashboards hide prefetch credits when routes spike. propose a per-route 'prefetch-pin' flag to surface prefetch ROI on the route card.
Kevin Lin: visibility vs attribution?
Maya Rao: both. flag = show prefetch credits inline + promote route in heatmap. opt-in default off.
Sudeep Patel: attribution issue: multi-model chains currently credit to first owner. suggest explicit header X-Prefetch-Owner: team/<slug> to make owner explicit in telemetry.
Liz Chen: UX: tiny "prefetch ROI" sparkline + 3-state badge (Net+/Net-/Neutral). tooltip linking to docs. show tokens per 1k invocations.
Kevin Lin: telemetry sketch: route_id, prefetch_pin=true, prefetch_owner, prefetch_credits, prefetch_savings, prefetch_latency_ms (nullable). keep backward compatibility; mark inferred when header missing.
ops-bot: created INF-1207 on data-ingest board: "support X-Prefetch-Owner header and prefetch_pin flag" :white_check_mark:
Maya Rao: rollout: (1) ingest schema, (2) console behind feature-flag + admin toggle (project-admin), (3) recompute last 7 days only for pinned routes, sample others at 1%.
Sudeep Patel: I'll post small schema diff by EOD.
Kevin Lin: I'll add admin endpoint; PR Wed AM.
Maya Rao: great. this should cut down 'ghost savings' confusion and speed ops triage.
